queries.label: vla-core
queries.why: Find VLA papers that directly model robot actions from vision and language.

queries.label: vla-named-models
queries.query: (all:RT-X OR all:Octo OR all:OpenVLA) AND all:"robot learning"
queries.why: Catch named robot foundation model families and comparative work.

queries.label: vla-open-x-embodiment
queries.query: (all:"Open X-Embodiment" OR all:"Open X Embodiment") AND all:robot
queries.why: Find cross-embodiment robot data mixtures that often form the real-robot layer of VLA data pyramids.

queries.label: vla-large-scale-robot-data
queries.why: Surface scaling and dataset-layer discussions for robot foundation models.

queries.label: vla-robot-foundation-action
queries.why: Find broader foundation-model papers whose metadata may not use VLA.

queries.label: vla-finetuning-policy
queries.why: Surface evidence about target-task adaptation and data requirements.

queries.label: vla-data-mixture
queries.query: all:"data mixture" AND all:"robot foundation model"
queries.why: Find mixture and dataset composition papers that explain scaling behavior.

queries.label: vla-negative-transfer
queries.query: all:"negative transfer" AND all:robot AND all:policy
queries.why: Search for failure cases where broad pretraining hurts target deployment.

queries.label: tactile-force-tactile-manipulation
queries.why: Find tactile sensing papers tied to manipulation policies or control.

queries.label: tactile-force-force-torque
queries.why: Cover force/torque observability and low-dimensional contact feedback.

queries.label: tactile-force-slip-detection
queries.why: Find tactile and force cues for grasp stability and material interaction.

queries.label: tactile-force-contact-rich
queries.why: Surface high-contact tasks where vision-only policies often fail.

queries.label: tactile-force-sensor-fusion
queries.query: all:"sensor fusion" AND all:tactile AND all:robot
queries.why: Find multimodal policies combining tactile, force, vision, or proprioception.

queries.label: ea-data-robot-demonstrations
queries.why: Find papers that treat demonstrations as reusable robot-learning data.

queries.label: ea-data-demonstration-quality
queries.why: Surface work that audits operator traces, consistency, and usable trajectory quality.

queries.label: ea-data-in-the-wild
queries.why: Capture natural-scene collection papers and their generalization tradeoffs.

queries.label: ea-data-dataset-curation
queries.why: Find dataset organization, filtering, metadata, and quality-control discussions.

queries.label: ea-sensor-multimodal-policy
queries.query: all:multimodal AND all:"robot manipulation" AND all:policy
queries.why: Find policy papers where sensor fusion affects manipulation behavior.

queries.label: ea-sensor-tactile-force
queries.query: all:tactile AND all:force AND all:"robot manipulation"
queries.why: Cover physical observability beyond RGB, especially contact and force cues.

queries.label: ea-sensor-point-cloud
queries.why: Find 3D perception papers relevant to spatial constraints and pose-sensitive tasks.

queries.label: ea-sensor-occlusion
queries.query: all:occlusion AND all:"robot perception" AND all:manipulation
queries.why: Expose perception failure cases where single-view RGB is insufficient.

queries.label: ea-model-named-foundation
queries.query: (all:RT-X OR all:Octo OR all:OpenVLA) AND all:robot
queries.why: Capture named robot foundation model lineages and follow-on comparisons.

queries.label: ea-model-finetuning
queries.why: Find evidence about whether pretraining reduces target-task data needs.

queries.label: ea-model-action-tokenization
queries.why: Surface model papers where action interfaces determine transfer behavior.
